test_title: PYST 57: SSC MTS 2024 - English Language and Comprehension (Held On: 12 Nov, 2024 - Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

My sister performed / brilliant / in the competition / yesterday.
solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. brilliant .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"brilliant"** is used incorrectly in the sentence. It should be replaced with the adverb **"brilliantly"** to describe how the sister performed.
 
• Adverbs are used to modify verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs. In this case, the verb **"performed"** requires an adverb for proper grammatical usage.
 
• Correct usage of adverbs ensures that the sentence conveys the action appropriately.

Correct sentence: *My sister performed **brilliantly** in the competition yesterday*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Adjectives describe nouns, while adverbs describe verbs, adjectives, or other adverbs.
 
• For example:
 
 
• **Incorrect:** He speaks polite.
 
• **Correct:** He speaks politely.
 
 
 
• Always ensure proper word forms are used based on the context of the sentence.
